en.headline: Jiao Jinshan takes silver in women's class 7 singles at Asian Para Games
en.dek: The Hong Kong paddler lost 2-3 to Wang Rui of the national team in the final after winning two games to level the match.
body: Hong Kong paddler Jiao Jinshan claimed silver in the women's class 7 singles at the Asian Para Games in Nagoya on Tuesday, falling 2-3 to Wang Rui of the national team.
The match stayed close throughout. After losing the first game, Jiao took the second 14-16 in deuce, then won the next two 11-9 to force a deciding fifth game. She lost the final 10-12 in deuce.
Earlier in the day Hong Kong's table tennis squad secured several bronze medals in other classes. Jiao had previously reached the final against the same opponent at the last Games.

zh.headline: 焦瑾珊亞殘運女子7級單打奪銀
zh.dek: 港隊球手周二決賽以2比3不敵國家隊王睿，在多局拉鋸後取得銀牌。
body: 香港乒乓球手焦瑾珊周二在名古屋亞殘運會女子7級單打決賽以2比3敗給國家隊王睿，奪得銀牌。
雙方多局均勢，焦瑾珊先失一局，第二局在刁時以14比16落敗，其後連贏兩局11比9追平，第五局再戰至刁時以10比12惜敗。
港隊當日在其他級別已摘下多面銅牌。焦瑾珊上屆亦曾在決賽對陣同一對手。
